idea-plugin.name: Sage IDE Support
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.7.2 — Fix a regression in the implicit sage.all namespace: commenting out `from sage.all import *` in a .sage file no longer leaves GF/ZZ/... flagged as unresolved references (the explicit-import gate is now PSI-based, so a commented-out import does not count).
  • 1.7.1 — The New-menu entry text for the Sage file template is now localized through the createFromTemplateActionReplacer pipeline: "Sage 文件" on a zh-CN IDE, "Sage File" otherwise.
  • 1.7.0 — "New → SageMath → Sage File" in the project view: create a fresh .sage file from the right-click New menu (file template with a hint that ^ is power / ^^ is XOR and sage.all is implicit).
  • 1.6.6 — The settings-preview descriptions of the Sage postfix templates are now in Chinese (matching the IDE language): every call-wrap key plus the .b2i/.i2b conversions.
  • 1.6.5 — Fix the settings page "Resource not found" error: every call-wrap postfix template now ships its own description.html (the preview panel resolves it as a static per-class resource and never consults the template's getDescription() method), so clicking .ZZ/.CC/... no longer logs a SEVERE error.
  • 1.6.4 — The new-template editor's condition list is trimmed to the Sage-accurate set: string / list / dict / set / tuple / non-None plus the ready-made sage.all class conditions (Integer, Rational, RealNumber, ComplexNumber, FinitePolyExtElement, Polynomial, Matrix, FreeModuleElement) and the class chooser. Python's number/iterable/boolean/exception categories are not offered — they misjudge sage types (sage numbers don't inherit builtins int/float/complex and sage containers don't inherit abc.Iterable).
  • 1.6.3 — Fix the .b2i/.i2b expansions (the selected expression is now substituted instead of the literal word "expr"); the settings preview of the call-wrap family no longer shows an extra dot in the after state (per-key preview resources); double-clicking a Sage template now opens the edit (rename) dialog like Python's built-ins; the new-template editor offers a Sage-apt condition set (expression kinds plus ready-made sage.all class conditions).
  • 1.6.2 — Postfix Completion settings: the Sage templates now appear under their own top-level "SageMathPostfix" group (registered under a Python-family meta-language) instead of being nested under Python, and the "+" button can create new Sage postfix templates (same editor as Python's, with expression-type conditions; created templates apply in .sage files only).
  • 1.6.1 — Fix the Sage postfix completion popup: SageFile now reports the Sage file type (getFileType() override, mirroring the platform's PyiFile pattern), so the postfix-applicability copy file is created as a SageFile and the .ZZ/.CC/... set appears in .sage files. The .b2i/.i2b keys now carry the platform-required leading dot (.b2i/.i2b), fixing both their popup entries and expansion.
  • 1.6.0 — Full caret lexical remapping to Sage preparse semantics: ^ parses as power (e^254 now follows the __pow__ type chain), ^= as power assignment, ^^ as bitwise XOR and ^^= as XOR assignment — all while the on-screen text never changes. The misused-^ inspection now targets these remapped forms and its ^= quick fix writes ^^= directly. The postfix provider now returns only the Sage template set; Python's built-in postfix templates are collected automatically through the base-language chain.
  • 1.5.0 — Sage postfix completion: .ZZ/.QQ/.RR/.CC/.SR/.Integer/.N/.factor/.show/.vector/.matrix, plus CTF number theory (.euler_phi, .carmichael_lambda, .divisors, .number_of_divisors, .prime_factors, .squarefree_part, .next_prime, .random_prime, .primitive_root, .factorial, .numerator, .denominator, .continued_fraction, .cyclotomic_polynomial, .sage_eval) and bytes/int conversion (.b2i, .i2b); Python's built-in postfix set stays available. New inspection: flags ^ / ^= in unambiguous bytes contexts (Sage power vs Python XOR) with a quick fix to ^^. The Sage lexer now merges the ^^ pair into one XOR token, so the correct Sage XOR spelling no longer shows a parser error.
  • 1.4.1 — Fix PsiInvalidElementAccessException on PyCharm 2026.2: stale stub-index elements are re-validated and never dereferenced through a dropped AST node.
  • 1.4.0 — Supports the whole PyCharm 2026 release year (261–263); GitHub Actions CI builds the plugin and attaches tagged releases.
  • 1.3.2 — The project tree shows the Sage icon for .sage files (file PSI override).
idea-plugin.description:
First-class Sage file support in PyCharm: .sage files are recognized as their own "Sage" file type (Python language intelligence underneath) with full Sage preparse-sugar semantics.
  • Registers a dedicated Sage file type for *.sage with all Python indexing, inspections and completion.
  • Types Sage generator statements (F.<a> = GF(2^8, ...), R.<x> = GF(2)[]): F receives the constructor's stub return type, a/x receive the element type from _first_ngens.
  • Resolves generator references inside sugar statements (e.g. x in modulus=x^8 + ... navigates to its declaration).
  • Suppresses parser-error squiggles on sugar statements only, keeping genuine errors red.
Requires the Python Community Edition plugin and the Sage type stubs installed by sage-pycharm-stubgen --install in the WSL Sage environment (configured as the project SDK). If .sage was manually associated with another type in Settings | Editor | File Types, remove that association so this plugin's Sage file type applies.

localInspection.displayName: Misused ^ operator (Sage power vs Python XOR)
